data.desc: TransAct Technologies Incorporated is a global leader in integrated solutions that enable the world's most valued brands to operate more efficiently, effectively, and economically. Its integrated solutions help digitally transform foodservices, and casino and gaming operations worldwide. In casino and gaming, EPIC by TransAct powers gaming environments with high-speed TITO, table games and kiosk printing, while EPICENTRAL enables real-time player engagement to enhance the customer experience and drive revenue. With 23,000 units in use globally, BOHA! helps customers strengthen food safety, streamline operations and provide visibility and control to large brand name multi-location food service companies. Together, these solutions are engineered to make every transaction count.
